name: claude-share
description: Keep your projects and your Claude Code setup identical on every machine.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --format=esm --outfile=dist/cs.js --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);" --log-level=warning
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run unit && bash tests/run-local.sh
